$sources: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 2.3 (live loads: crane loads; clause number and page to be checked against the BNBC text)
ASCE 7-05 Sec 4.10 (crane loads), the same provisions
source: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 2.3, crane loads (page not checked): maximum wheel loads with vertical impact, lateral force on the runway beams, longitudinal force

sources.impact: Vertical impact: powered monorail, cab-operated or remotely operated bridge cranes 25 %, pendant-operated bridge cranes 10 %, hand-geared bridge, trolley and hoist 0 %
sources.lateral: 20 % of the rated capacity plus the weight of the hoist and trolley, at the top of the rails, shared by the runway beams by their lateral stiffness, either direction
sources.longitudinal: 10 % of the maximum wheel loads, at the top of the rail (bridge cranes with hand-geared bridges excepted)
